description: NaBa₂Sr₂(SbO₄)₃ is (Cubic) Perovskite-derived structured and crystallizes in the tetragonal P̅4n2 space group. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SbO₆ octahedra, faces with four equivalent BaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with four equivalent SrO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-6°. There are four shorter (2.25 Å) and two longer (2.26 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Ba is bonded to twelve O atoms to form BaO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent BaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent SrO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and faces with six SbO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Ba-O bond distances ranging from 2.89-3.02 Å. Sr is bonded to twelve O atoms to form SrO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent SrO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent BaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and faces with six SbO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Sr-O bond distances ranging from 2.83-3.06 Å. There are two inequivalent Sb sites. In the first Sb site, Sb is bonded to six O atoms to form SbO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent SbO₆ octahedra, faces with four equivalent BaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with four equivalent SrO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-7°. There are two shorter (1.91 Å) and four longer (2.08 Å) Sb-O bond lengths. In the second Sb site, Sb is bonded to six O atoms to form SbO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four SbO₆ octahedra, faces with four equivalent BaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with four equivalent SrO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-7°. There are a spread of Sb-O bond distances ranging from 1.92-2.09 Å. There are five inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Ba, two equivalent Sr, and two equivalent Sb atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and face-sharing OBa₂Sr₂Sb₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-61°. In the second O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Ba, two equivalent Sr, and two equivalent Sb atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and face-sharing OBa₂Sr₂Sb₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-61°. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to one Na, two equivalent Ba, two equivalent Sr, and one Sb atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to one Na, two equivalent Ba, two equivalent Sr, and one Sb atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Ba, two equivalent Sr, and two Sb atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and face-sharing OBa₂Sr₂Sb₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 2-62°.
